title: filenode MemoryBackend query_objects ignores sort
description: crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs query_objects takes _sort and always orders by id. RFC 8620 §5.5: the server MUST sort per the sort argument or reject an unsupported one with unsupportedSort; silently ignoring it returns a wrongly ordered page. Found while fixing JMAP-yt1w.22 (which made the same impl honour position/anchor and report total before paging). Fix: apply RFC 8620 §5.5 / filenode-draft comparators, or return BackendQueryError::Method(JmapError::unsupported_sort()) for comparators it cannot apply.
